title: Property and buildings
description: Match addresses to parcels and check assessor ownership, parcel boundaries and mapped building footprints.

title: Power and renewables
description: Look up mapped substation voltage and screen a parcel for solar nameplate capacity. Confirm available grid capacity with a project-specific study.

title: Hazards and underwriting
description: Check mapped flood zones, California wildfire classifications and tract-level hail frequency.

title: Zoning, terrain and water
description: Review reported zoning, parcel acreage net of mapped wetlands and water service area intersections.

title: Transport and connectivity
description: Find mapped road and rail proximity. The reported fiber indicator requires an operator key and describes an area.

title: Markets and valuation
description: Check the last recorded sale and its date. Read the county parcel value alongside the basis the county reports.

title: Retail and trade areas
description: Check tract population, county household income and straight-line distance to groceries. Use a drive-time boundary to estimate reachable households.

title: Farmland and soils
description: Review the dominant crop at a sampled point, soil drainage and the current drought map. Compare fields across the farm boundary before estimating acreage.
guideLabel: Check crop history across a parcel

title: Weather and cooling
description: Screen cooling conditions using a typical-year wet-bulb estimate, a long-run temperature normal and hours below a dry-bulb threshold.
